nodes.name: Demo Request Webhook
nodes.notes: TODO: after activating, copy the real Production URL from this node and set it as NEXT_PUBLIC_ELLIOT_DEMO_REQUEST_WEBHOOK_URL in the elliot-web Vercel project. Public endpoint -- no tenant auth, this is a sales lead for Elliot itself, not a tenant-scoped request.

parameters.query:
-- 0037: also a lead in the Elliot sales account (if it exists), and the
-- notification goes to the platform alert email (Control panel → Health & alerts).
with ins as (
    insert into demo_requests (name, company, email, website, industry, employees, automate)
    values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
    returning *
)
select ins.*,
       upsert_sales_lead(ins.name, ins.email, null, ins.company,
           jsonb_build_object('employees', ins.employees, 'industry', ins.industry, 'website', ins.website, 'wants', ins.automate),
           'contact_form') as sales_contact_id,
       sales_notify_email() as notify_to
from ins;

nodes.name: Insert Demo Request
nodes.notes: REQUIRES: 0017_demo_requests.sql applied. Same shared Postgres credential used across the other workflows -- service role bypasses RLS, which is what we want here since demo_requests has no tenant_id.
